summary: George Russell won the Austrian Grand Prix from pole position, 1.6s ahead of Max Verstappen, with Kimi Antonelli completing the podium.
Max Verstappen made the biggest climb, from P5 to P2.
Charles Leclerc had a day to forget, dropping from P2 to P8.
The race was neutralised by 2 virtual safety cars.
The stewards penalised ALO (5 second time penalty).
There were 41 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 40 points over George Russell.
